# DeltaQuery v0.2.3 - Table of Contents

An Elixir library for querying Delta Sharing tables.

## Pages

- [Code of Conduct](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/code_of_conduct.md)
- [Releasing a new version](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/releases.md)
- [Contributing and Development](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [DeltaQuery](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [DeltaQuery](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.md): Elixir client for querying Delta Sharing tables.
- [DeltaQuery.Client](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.Client.md): HTTP client for Delta Sharing REST API.
- [DeltaQuery.Column](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.Column.md): Represents a column in a Delta table schema.

- [DeltaQuery.Config](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.Config.md): Runtime configuration for Delta Query client.
- [DeltaQuery.FixtureHelper](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.FixtureHelper.md): Helper module for loading test fixtures in tests.

- [DeltaQuery.PredicateParser](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.PredicateParser.md): Parser for predicate expressions using NimbleParsec.
- [DeltaQuery.Query](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.Query.md): Composable query builder for Delta Sharing tables.
- [DeltaQuery.Results](https://delta-query.hexdocs.pm/DeltaQuery.Results.md): In-memory operations on query results.
